title: Singlet oxygen is not the source of ethylene carbonate degradation in nickel-rich Li-ion cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00956A, Paper
Open Access

Rory C. McNulty, Kieran D. Jones, Benjamin M. G. Denison, Elizabeth Hampson, Israel Temprano, Darren A. Walsh, Hon Wai Lam, Graham N. Newton, Wesley M. Dose, Clare P. Grey, Lee R. Johnson
Photochemical assessment shows ethylene carbonate does not react with singlet oxygen, indicating degradation within nickel-rich cells follows an alternative route.
